description: Programming in Python from the first print statement to objects, files, graphics, networked clients and event-driven GUIs, with a working program every week. Taught to the depth of a leading introductory programming course in Python.
modelledOn: Lambert, Fundamentals of Python: First Programs
Guttag, Introduction to Computation and Programming Using Python
outcomes: Write Python programs that use expressions, control structures and functions correctly and idiomatically.
Process text, lists, dictionaries and files to solve information-processing tasks.
Choose and implement simple algorithms and reason about their running time.
Design classes with attributes, methods, inheritance and special methods.
Manipulate images and draw graphics programmatically.
Build a networked client and an event-driven graphical interface.

units.title: Python and programming fundamentals
topics: The interpreter, the shell and scripts; installing Python and an editor
Values, types (int, float, str, bool), variables, assignment, expressions and operators
Input and output; f-strings and formatting
Modules and the standard library: math, random, time
Pythonic style: PEP 8, naming, comments and docstrings

units.title: Control structures and functions
topics: if, elif, else; Boolean logic and truthiness
while and for loops; range; break, continue, else on loops
Defining functions, parameters, default and keyword arguments, return values, scope
Recursion: factorial, Fibonacci, binary search, drawing a Sierpinski triangle
Exceptions: try, except, finally, raise; validating user input

units.title: Strings, text files, lists and dictionaries
topics: String indexing, slicing, methods, immutability; Unicode and encoding
Lists: methods, slicing, nested lists, list comprehensions; tuples
Dictionaries and sets: counting words, lookup tables, grouping
Reading and writing text files; CSV and JSON; processing a file of exam results or sales records
Mutability, aliasing and copying

units.title: Algorithms and information processing
topics: Linear and binary search; selection, insertion and merge sort; using sorted with keys
Counting steps and big-O informally; timing with time and timeit
Simple data analysis: mean, median, mode, histograms from a data file
Regular expressions for extracting phone numbers and dates
Command-line programs with arguments

units.title: Objects and classes
topics: Classes, __init__, attributes, methods, self
Special methods: __str__, __repr__, __eq__, __lt__, operator overloading
Inheritance, polymorphism, super; composition versus inheritance
Data structures as classes: a stack, a queue, a linked list, a bank account
Modules, packages and unit testing with unittest or pytest

units.title: Graphics and image processing
topics: Turtle graphics: coordinates, shapes, recursion for fractals
Images as grids of pixels; loading and saving images with Pillow
Grayscale, invert, brightness, blur, edge detection as loops over pixels
Drawing charts without a library; introduction to matplotlib

units.title: Networks and client/server programming
topics: Sockets: IP addresses, ports, TCP; a simple echo client and server
HTTP from Python: urllib and requests; fetching a web page and a JSON API
Parsing HTML and JSON responses; a weather or exchange-rate client
Building a small chat application; blocking calls and threads

units.title: Graphical user interfaces
topics: tkinter windows, widgets, labels, buttons, entries, text boxes
Layout managers: pack, grid; frames and canvases
Model-view separation: keeping logic out of the GUI
A temperature converter and a to-do list application

units.title: Events and event-driven programming
topics: The event loop; callbacks and command bindings
Mouse and keyboard events; timers with after
A simple drawing program and a small game on a canvas
Project: an event-driven application with files, classes and a GUI

schedule.title: First programs: values, types and input
schedule.exercise: Trace by hand the values of every variable in a short program that computes a trader's change in cedis and write down the final output.

tasks.title: Write a program that stores the price and quantity of three items, computes the total in cedis and prints it with two decimals
Read a name and a mobile money amount with input, convert types correctly and print a formatted receipt using f-strings
Debug a given program that mixes strings and numbers and gives wrong totals, fix all five type errors and explain each one in comments

schedule.title: Modules and Pythonic style
schedule.exercise: Rewrite a poorly named 15-line script using PEP 8 naming, comments and docstrings, and explain each change in one line.

tasks.title: Use the math module to compute the area and circumference of five circles and print them rounded to one decimal place
Use random and time to simulate 1000 dice rolls, time the loop, and report the frequency of each face
Refactor a given 40-line unit conversion script into documented functions with PEP 8 style while keeping its output identical

schedule.title: Conditions, loops and functions
schedule.exercise: Write pseudocode and then Python for a fare calculator that charges by distance with a student discount, and test it on six trips.

tasks.title: Write a grade program with if, elif and else that maps marks to letter grades and test the boundaries at 39, 40, 69 and 70
Print a multiplication table and the prime numbers up to 100 using nested loops, with break and continue, and check against known values
Write a function with default and keyword arguments that computes loan repayments, and test it for ten parameter combinations

schedule.title: Recursion and exceptions
schedule.exercise: Explain on paper the call stack of a recursive factorial of 5, showing each call and return.

tasks.title: Step through recursive Fibonacci of 5 and count the repeated calls, then draw the call tree
Write a recursive binary search and a recursive Sierpinski drawing function and test them on given inputs
Build an input validation loop that accepts only a valid Ghana phone number or age with try, except and finally, and test it on 12 bad inputs

schedule.title: Strings, lists, dictionaries and sets
schedule.exercise: Count the most common words in a paragraph by hand for the first two sentences and compare with your program's output.

tasks.title: Slice and transform a string to extract initials, reverse a word and detect a palindrome for six given words
Use list comprehensions to filter and transform a list of 20 exam scores and compute the pass list and the average
Count word frequencies in a paragraph with a dictionary, group the words by length with sets and print the top five

schedule.title: Files, data formats and aliasing
schedule.exercise: Predict the output of a short program that copies a list in three ways and explain why changes appear or do not appear in the original.

tasks.title: Trace the memory diagram of a list assigned to two names, then copied, and note which edits affect which variable
Read a CSV of 30 exam results, compute each student's average and write the ranking to a new file
Read a JSON file of sales records, find the best-selling product by month, handle missing fields, and write a summary JSON

schedule.title: Algorithms, analysis and command-line tools
schedule.exercise: Compare binary search with linear search for 1000 items by counting the maximum steps in each and explain the difference.

tasks.title: Step through insertion sort on a list of eight numbers and write the list after each pass
Time linear search, binary search and sorted lookups on lists of 1000, 10000 and 100000 items and plot the growth against big-O predictions
Extract phone numbers and dates from a messy block of text with regular expressions, then test on 15 tricky strings and report any misses

schedule.title: Classes and inheritance
schedule.exercise: Draw a class diagram for a bank account system with a savings and a current account and list the methods each class needs.

tasks.title: Write a Student class with attributes and methods, create five objects and print each with a method
Add __str__, __eq__ and __lt__ to a Money class and use them to sort and compare a list of 8 amounts
Build a class hierarchy of vehicles with polymorphic fare methods, then rewrite one part with composition and compare which design is easier to extend

schedule.title: Data structures as classes and testing
schedule.exercise: Write a short test plan listing ten cases for a Stack class, covering empty, full and normal behaviour.

tasks.title: Implement a Stack class with push, pop and peek, then use it to check balanced brackets in six strings
Implement a linked list and watch it step by step as you insert, delete and reverse nodes, checking the pointers after each operation
Write unit tests for a bank account class covering deposits, overdrafts and invalid input, and fix the bugs the tests reveal

schedule.title: Graphics, images and charts
schedule.exercise: Describe how you would blur an image in plain language, listing exactly which pixels are averaged for a given pixel.

tasks.title: Draw a spiral and a recursive tree with turtle graphics from given parameters and check the shapes against the expected picture
Load a small grid of grayscale pixel values and apply invert, brightness and a 3x3 blur, printing the result matrix
Draw a text bar chart of rainfall for 12 months without a library, then reproduce it with matplotlib and compare

schedule.title: Networking and web clients
schedule.exercise: Draw the sequence of messages for a client fetching a web page from a server, marking where TCP and HTTP each begin.

tasks.title: Write a simple echo server and client that exchange five messages over a socket in the simulated environment
Fetch a JSON exchange rate response, parse it, and print cedi values for three currencies, handling a failed request gracefully
Build a small chat server with threads that serves two clients, then find and fix a blocking call that freezes one of them

schedule.title: GUI programming with tkinter
schedule.exercise: Sketch a layout for a to-do application on paper and write down which widgets and layout manager you would use for each region.

tasks.title: Build a tkinter-style window with a label, an entry and a button that prints the entry text when clicked
Write a temperature converter with separate conversion functions and GUI code, then test the functions without opening a window
Build a to-do list application where the data model is separate from the interface, with add, delete and save to file features

schedule.title: Event-driven programming and project
schedule.exercise: Write a project plan with milestones for an event-driven application and a test list of at least eight user actions.

tasks.title: Wire three buttons to callbacks that change a counter and a label, and print the order of events for a scripted click sequence
Build a drawing program that responds to mouse and key events with undo and a timer that clears the canvas, and test eight event sequences
Build and demonstrate an event-driven application with classes, file storage and a GUI, supported by at least 10 passing unit tests
